summary: Unsigned executable or script staging out of %TEMP% with orphaned lineage. Common in commodity downloaders and MITRE ATT&CK T1059.003 dropper chains.

steps.action: Isolate affected host or container network interface
steps.rationale: Stops live C2 traffic and prevents payload propagation.

steps.action: Capture volatile memory and enumerate injected modules
steps.rationale: Temp dropper families often unpack to memory-only beacons.

steps.action: Query Sysmon Event IDs 1/10/11 for parent lineage and file writes
steps.rationale: Correlates stage0 installer or LOLBin used to launch payload.

steps.action: Compare hash/path with threat intel repositories
steps.rationale: Confirms KEV coverage or marks as novel for hunting.

steps.action: Sweep enterprise for sibling hashes and mutex artifacts
steps.rationale: Detects secondary footholds before remediation completes.
